clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Carolai Anise teaches alchemy while her experiments make the guards uneasy.

Carolai Anise pursues alchemy in Brill, where she teaches novice alchemists. Many Forsaken researchers work under the Royal Apothecary Society's grim mandate, but Carolai makes her own strange brews inside the settlement. Her unpredictable experiments and smoking retorts are well known. The Deathguards watching Brill openly grumble that she seems bent on blowing up her own house.
